inicial.meta_descricao: Carbono Consciente: mātauranga taiao mō te tukunga waro, te tapuwae waro, ngā tohutohu toitū, ngā mea whakamīharo, me ngā pūrongo taiao.

hero.titulo: He iti noa ngā tikanga, engari he māmā ake te taumaha ki te ao
hero.texto: EHARA A CARBONO CONSCIENTE I TE TOHU KĀKĀRIKI, EHARA ANŌ I TE WHĀINGA TAWHITI — KO TE HUA KĒ IA O NGĀ WHIRIWHIRINGA NOA, E TAUNGA TONU ANA I IA RĀ: KO TE AHA KEI TE WHAKATOKA KOE, PEHEA TŌ HAERENGA, ĀHUA AHA TE WĀ KA WEROA E KOE TE RAMA, KEI HEA TŌ MAKA PARA.

acordeao.emissao_corpo: Ko te tukunga waro ko te tukunga o ngā haurehu pēnei i te CO₂ ki te kōrahi, nā te tahu wāhie konukore, te tua ngahere, te hanga ahumahi, tae atu ki te waka o ia rā.
acordeao.clima_titulo: He pēhea tōna pāpātanga ki te āhuarangi?
acordeao.clima_corpo: Ka hanga ngā haurehu whare kāriki he papa pupuri wera i te kōrahi. Ka nui ake te tukunga, ka kaha ake tēnei pānga — ko tēnei te take o te whakamahana o te ao me te huringa āhuarangi.
acordeao.pegada_corpo: Koinei te huinga katoa o ngā haurehu whare kāriki e puta ana, mā te ara tōtika, mā te ara autaki rānei, nā ngā mahi a te tangata, a te kamupene, a te hua rānei i tōna oranga o ia rā.
acordeao.neutro_corpo: Ko te waro taurite e ngana ana ki te whakatōpū, ki te whakarite rānei i ngā tukunga kua puta. Ko Carbono consciente e whakamua ana i ngā whiriwhiringa e whakaiti ana i te pāpātanga taiao, i mua tonu i te whakaaro ki te whakarite utu.

globo.sem_dados_territorio: Kāore he raraunga mō te tukunga CO₂ mō te tangata takitahi mō tēnei rohe.
globo.fonte_estimativa: He tātai mō te CO₂ konukore mō te tangata takitahi (Global Carbon Budget / Our World in Data, tau tūāpapa 2024).
globo.aria_interativo: He ao whakapātaritari o ngā tukunga waro. Tōia kia hurihuri, pāwhiri rere kia whakanui, pāwhiritia tētahi whenua kia kite i ōna raraunga, ā, tāruatia te pāwhiri kia whakanui i te ao.
globo.aria_decorativo: He ao whakapaipai e hurihuri ana, e whakaatu ana i te whānuitanga o te ao o te kaupapa Carbono Consciente.
